[[Marhan's Grotto]] is an [[outpost]] to the south of [[Ice Floe]]. Its a small grotto where the ground is covered in ice, which causes players to move slowly due to the [[Icy Ground|icy ground]] effect. Marhan's Grotto is home to one of [[Prophecies]]' prestige [[armourer]]s, [[Karl]].  
{{Quotation|game|
Once, [[Dwarf|Dwarves]] from all over the Shiverpeaks made the trek here to barter with [[Marhan the Mighty]], a [[weaponsmith]] who was reputed for making the best axes in all the land. After he passed into the [[Great Forge]], this grotto was named in his honor.
}}

== Getting there ==
* From [[Thunderhead Keep (outpost)|Thunderhead Keep]], go southwest through [[Ice Floe]].
* Alternatively, you can head south from [[Iron Mines of Moladune (outpost)|Iron Mines of Moladune]], into Ice Floe and then southeast to Marhan's Grotto. This is useful if you wish to get prestige armor before getting it [[Infusion|infused]]; however, because of the [[Mursaat]] and [[Jade construct|Jade]], the journey is very difficult and is best done with [[hero]]es, whose armor is always infused.
* Marhan's Grotto is located very nearly on the most southern point of [[Ice Floe]].

== Notes ==
* This is one of the two outposts where you can craft [[prestige armor]] in the Prophecies campaign.  The other outpost is [[The Granite Citadel]].
* Most of Marhan's Grotto is situated on ice.  Thus, while you are in the outpost you are affected by [[Icy Ground]] which slows your movement by 70% unless you are constantly moving. Keep running until you get to a spot of dry land.
